why: The reduced-motion half of the held fallback pip (issue #1055, criterion 4): under `.hud--reduced-motion` the held cued pip selects `hud-stock-pip-empty--still`, which also ends on the lost pip's 2px border, so the reduced form drops the information instead of keeping it -- measured in Chromium before the fix, the same 2px 1.5s after the loss. The reduced-motion guard still passes, because the name still ends in `--still`; only the test that reads the keyframe set the held pip ends up with, with the policy class on, can see it.
killedBy: hud.css: the stock-loss cue arms (issue #230) keeps a cued pip the player still holds filled once its cue ends, with motion and without (issue #1055)
